name: flyleaf
description: A Safari-style reader mode for the web — distraction-free reading, arrow-key page navigation, themes, and per-site memory.
author: anubra266

scripts.build: find . -name .DS_Store -delete && rm -f dist/flyleaf-*.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r -X "dist/flyleaf-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip" manifest.json src vendor icons -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.release: npm run bump && npm run build
